_note: Backend crossover at 10 physical qubits, 12 parents x 64 candidates = 768 labels over 2 families. Parents must be at least three per family (6 here) or generation.parent_splits cannot fill train/validation/test. teacher.mode=none, so this measures propagation throughput. Fewer labels at large sizes amortise CuPy's fixed startup over less work, biasing the ratio DOWN against the GPU -- the conservative direction.
